Definition: Abshalom, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Absalom or Abishalom = "my father is peace"; 1) father-in-law of Rehoboam; 2) third son of David, killer of first-born son Amnon, also leader of revolt against his father-David
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
